title: SALIENDO stops blinking
description: SALIENDO drops its pulsing animation for a static, solid-amber chip (amber background, dark text, matching amber dot rendered in the background color). Trades urgency-via-motion for a steadier board that still reads as the most emphasized state through solid fill rather than flashing.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row--departing (whole row blinks via mb-pulse-equivalent animation) and .arrival-row__departing's pulsing amber dot
warning: Removes the blink animation on the departing row/dot. No TransitionGroup or transition-based motion is introduced or removed elsewhere; this only disables an existing CSS keyframe animation, so it is safe under the no-TransitionGroup constraint.

changes.intent: Stop the row-level blink animation so SALIENDO reads as steady/solid instead of flashing.
changes.detail: Removes the pulsing opacity animation currently applied to the whole departing row.

changes.intent: Render SALIENDO as a solid, static amber chip instead of plain animated text.
Stop the dot's own pulse animation and recolor it to contrast against the now-solid amber chip background.
changes.detail: The dot no longer needs to pulse for attention since the chip itself is now a solid, always-visible amber fill.
